about: The names that SOLIDWORKS writes only as localized text, one row per name and one column per language. The code asks for a key (feature.cut_extrude), never for a word: the column is chosen by the language SOLIDWORKS runs in (ISldWorks.GetCurrentLanguage) and, for the names of features, documents and sheets, by the toggle Use English feature and file names. A language with no column falls back to English with a warning in the document state. Whatever the API can answer without a name (types, ids, column types, rotations) is read from the API and is NOT in this table.

domains.feature: names of features, sketches, axes, sheets and new documents (the names a template stores, such as its planes, its configurations and the sheet of a new drawing, stay in the language of the template): SOLIDWORKS writes them in English when the toggle Use English feature and file names is on, whatever the language of the interface
domains.ui: texts of the interface that end up in a document (view names, hole callouts, cut-list property names, reserved variable names): they follow the language of the interface
